step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard shows a standard application architecture boilerplate separated into runtime and CI/CD/deployment stacks. On the runtime side, CloudFront connects to S3 for static content. An ALB routes web traffic to ECS container tasks, which interact with OpenSearch, ElastiCache, and RDS for persistence and search. On the CI/CD side, CodePipeline handles build outputs pushed to ECR, alongside CloudFormation for infrastructure orchestration.
